svg.title: V-08. N2 chart · interfaces between components and their neighbours (SysML v2 view interfaceN2)
svg.desc: N2 chart generated from the SysML v2 model. The diagonal holds the components E-01 to E-05 inside the item boundary and the outside elements they connect to; a cell (row, column) names the interfaces over which the row element sends to the column element, coloured by the edge class of V-01 and V-03.
svg.text: V-08 · N2 chart · interfaces between components and their neighbours
Every connection of the model rolled up to the components E-01 to E-05 and the elements outside the item

Read a row across: the row element sends to the column element over the interfaces in the cell (IF-nn of WP-S-03 §3.3; CAN = bus attachment, both ways; no IF = a model link with no IF number). Diagonal: the elements.
SoC control of MCU boot (FFI, CS)
